Chicka Chicka Boom Boom Printable Pack

This year, I’m back in the classroom teaching a preschool literacy class at a local homeschool co-op. We spent our time this past class reading and playing with Chicka Chicka Boom Boom. This is one of my favorite alphabet books!

Of course, I had to create some printables to go along with our alphabet theme. Today, I’m sharing some of them with you. {Note: The complete pack with blackline printables can be found in The Library.}

In this fun pack, I have included activities for letter recognition as well as fine motor skills.

  • Chicka Chicka Letter Match ~ My learners used uppercase magnetic letters and/or lowercase magnetic letters.
  • Chicka Chicka Alphabet ~ A handy chart to work on letter recognition.

 

  • Chicka Chicka Letter Climb ~ My learners used this activity with letter stamps.
  • Chicka Chicka Coconuts ~ Use with dot paint, dot stickers, letter stamps, or pom-poms and tongs.
  • Chicka Chicka Coloring Page ~ Find & color the lowercase letters of the alphabet.

 

 

Enjoy this free pack!
~Becky
